guides.intro: What a Retribution paladin presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. A paladin's fight is simple: a seal on yourself, your weapon's swings, and two strikes on 10-second cooldowns. Most new spells are safety tools, not rotation. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Seal of Righteousness
stages.change: **Seal of Righteousness** on yourself, then your weapon does the work.
press: **Seal of Righteousness** before the pull. It lasts 30 seconds: put it back when it runs out.
notes: Keep **Devotion Aura** on. Heal with **Holy Light** between fights.
Use a two-handed weapon from the first one you find. Every seal and strike hits harder with a slow, heavy weapon.

stages.title: Judgement
stages.change: **Judgement** unleashes your seal on the mob every 10 seconds. In Forever the seal stays up afterwards.

stages.title: Holy Strike
stages.change: **Holy Strike**, an instant weapon strike every 10 seconds. With **Judgement** it is your whole rotation until 20.
notes: **Seal of the Crusader** (6) is not part of the leveling rotation. Stay on **Seal of Righteousness**.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health: **Divine Protection**, then **Holy Light** inside it.

stages.title: Hammer of Justice
stages.change: **Hammer of Justice**, a stun: stop a caster, or buy time to heal.
press: **Hammer of Justice** a mob that casts spells. It stands back and casts until you stop it.
notes: **Purify** (8) removes a poison or a disease. It is not part of the fight.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health, with the mob still above a quarter of its own: **Divine Protection** and **Holy Light** inside it, or **Hammer of Justice** and **Holy Light** during the stun.

stages.title: Talents begin, Lay on Hands
stages.change: Talent points start. **Lay on Hands** is a full heal for emergencies. Nothing new to press in a normal fight.
press: **Hammer of Justice** a mob that casts spells.
notes: **Seal of Fury** (10) and **Righteous Fury** (10) are for tanking. Leave them alone while you level as Retribution.
**Retribution Aura** (16) hurts whatever hits you. The fight lab assumes **Devotion Aura**; against single mobs either is fine.
**Blessing of Protection** (10) and **Blessing of Freedom** (18) are tools for a bad pull, not rotation.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health, with the mob still above a quarter of its own: **Divine Protection** and **Holy Light** inside it, or **Hammer of Justice** and **Holy Light** during the stun. **Lay on Hands** below 15%.

stages.title: Seal of Command and the stun combo
stages.change: **Seal of Command** (talent) replaces Seal of Righteousness. Its **Judgement** hits a stunned mob twice as hard, so stun first.
press: **Hammer of Justice** a mob that casts spells.
**Hammer of Justice**, then **Judgement**, when both are ready and the mob has more than 30% of its health left.
notes: **Consecration** (20): leave it off your bar against single mobs. The tuned rotation never casts it. It is for packs.
**Exorcism** (20) only works on Undead and Demons. Use it on cooldown against those; the fight lab does not model it.

**Blessing of Kings** (20) is an alternative to **Blessing of Might**; the fight lab plays **Blessing of Might**. From 34, **Divine Shield** replaces **Divine Protection** as your bubble: longer, and it takes the same key.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health, with the mob still above a quarter of its own: **Divine Protection** and **Holy Light** inside it, or **Hammer of Justice** and **Holy Light** during the stun. **Flash of Light** below a quarter. **Lay on Hands** below 15%.

stages.title: Hammer of Wrath
stages.change: **Hammer of Wrath**, a ranged finisher for mobs below 20% health. Optional: the tuned rotation leaves it out.
press: **Hammer of Justice** a mob that casts spells.
**Hammer of Justice**, then **Judgement**, when both are ready and the mob has more than 30% of its health left.
notes: **Hammer of Wrath** (44) hits a mob below 20% health from range. The tuned rules of 2026-11-02 switch it off against single mobs: kills measured no faster with it. Use it on a mob that runs.
**Holy Wrath** (50) only works on Undead and Demons, like **Exorcism**.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health, with the mob still above a quarter of its own: **Divine Shield** and **Holy Light** inside it, or **Hammer of Justice** and **Holy Light** during the stun. **Flash of Light** below a quarter. **Lay on Hands** below 15%.

between: Heal yourself back to about 80% with **Holy Light**, or with **Flash of Light** from level 20.
Drink only when you are below about 15% of your mana. Judgements and strikes are cheap, and your swings cost nothing.
Re-cast **Blessing of Might** when it runs out, and your seal just before each pull.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of your seal and **Holy Strike**.
other: A paladin who wants to arrive at 60 as a healer or a tank can level into that build instead. The Holy and Protection leveling pages in this folder show how, and what it costs in speed.
Packs of mobs: **Consecration** and the Protection tree's tools. Single pulls are faster for Retribution.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; the blessing, the aura, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme matches your mage: Q the strike you press most, E the control, R the payoff after it, F the escape, the thumb buttons the reactions. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup and the macro: the [paladin keybinds page](../research/leveling/keybinds.md).

slots.role: The payoff: hits a stunned mob twice as hard from 20
Extra damage on Undead and Demons
Cure a poison or a disease

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift (packs, buffs, travel)

slots.role: The stun combo in one key
A second save: no physical damage
Send an extra Undead mob running
Undead and Demons: the area version

notes: The combo from 20 is E then R: **Hammer of Justice**, then **Judgement** on the stunned mob. Shift+E does both in two presses if you like macros.
Two swaps on bar 1 in the whole climb: **Seal of Command** takes 1 at level 20, and **Divine Shield** takes F at 34.
Levels 1-5 fight with two keys: 1 for the seal and R for **Judgement** from 4. The middle mouse button starts your swings; a right-click on the mob does the same.
The seal keeps its key: it lasts 30 seconds, so you recast it in the middle of longer fights, and the stun combo needs **Seal of Command** up.
No key: **Blessing of Might**, **Devotion Aura**, food, drink, bandages, the mount and the Hearthstone. Put them on a side bar and click them between fights.
The tuned rotation leaves **Hammer of Wrath** and **Consecration** out against single mobs. Their keys are for a mob that runs and for packs.
